context: Tekla Structures Educational version, English, mm. 'End plate (101)' between a column and a beam; its dialog (tabs Picture, End plate, General, Notch, Bolts, Design, Analysis) is open 00:43-02:16.

pieces.ask: the profiles of the column and the beam (property pane, labels, narrator); whether the beam lands on the column flange or web; the Picture tab: every box (gap, edge distances) and its value; the End plate tab: plate t, b, h, Pos_No, material, name, edge type, every box and its value.

the Bolts tab: bolt size, standard, tolerance, thread in material, site/workshop, the vertical group (reference, edge distance, number of bolts and spacing as separate boxes, exactly as written) and the horizontal group (reference, edge distance, number of bolts, spacing); every change and Modify press.

the finished joint in the 3D view: end plate size relative to the beam, the number of bolt rows and bolt columns, where the plate sits (column flange or web); the status bar text and the component symbol colour (and whether selected).
